info.title: E.coli cells tracking dataset for GNN
info.subtitle: E.coli tracking - Graph Neural Network training dataset
info.description:
This is a dataset containing fluorescence time lapse images of E. coli cells (1 pixel = 0.11 mu), the corresponding cell information (lookup table), and the adjacency matrix. The data can be used for any tracking project.
 
This dataset was used to train a Graph Neural Network to track E.coli MG1655 cells in fluorescent time-lapse image stacks. For details see https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c02745

File format: npy
Each file contains:
images: numpy array (frames, height, width) uint16
look_up_table: numpy array (each row represent a cell width all its information in the current frame)
adjacency_matrix_gt: numpy array, this is a square array with dimensions length lookup table x length lookup table. Each row and column represents a cell in the lookup table.

The columns of the lookup table array:

tiff series (field of view tiff file)

ROI

frame

total number of cells in the ROI

cell number

bounding box centroid coordinate x

bounding box centroid coordinate y

bounding box min x coordinate

bounding box max x coordinate

bounding box min y coordinate

bounding box max y coordinate

cell centroid coordinate x

cell centroid coordinate y

cell width (in mu)

cell height (in mu)

cell angle (deg)
